snippet.title: Karnataka Launches Its Own Travel Passport! 🇮🇳📮 | People Queue From 6 AM
snippet.description:
Karnataka has introduced a special travel passport, and people are reportedly lining up early in the morning to get one! 📮❤️

Introduced by the Karnataka Postal Circle, this isn't an official international passport. It's a travel souvenir designed to help people collect stamps as they explore different destinations across Karnataka.

📍 Where was it available?
- Bengaluru General Post Office (GPO)
- Mangaluru
- Mysuru

The response has reportedly been strong, with limited quantities selling out quickly. Some people were said to have started waiting as early as the previous night.

The idea is simple: visit places across Karnataka, collect stamps and build a physical keepsake of your travels.

At a time when so many memories stay on our phones, this initiative offers a fun way to encourage local tourism and celebrate Karnataka's culture, heritage and destinations.
